text:
Anya (Support): Customer on v2 rerank reporting wrong ordering — scores look like strings with trailing zeros and some "-0.0000" values causing lexicographic sort. They repro with our TS SDK 0.8.1. @Tomas can you triage?

Tomas (SDK): Ack, can you paste the minimal repro (node snippet + server response)?

Anya (Support): Pasted from customer:

```js
// node 18, @redwood/sdk v0.8.1
const payload = {
  query: 'best laptop',
  candidates: ['A','B','C'],
  top_k: 3
}
const res = await client.rerank(payload)
console.log(JSON.stringify(payload))
console.log(res) // shows scores: ["0.1200","0.0600","0.0000"]
```

Curl response they captured: 

```json
{
  "candidates": ["A","B","C"],
  "scores": ["0.1200","0.0600","0.0000"]
}
```

Anya (Support): They said when client does `scores.sort()` they get wrong order because scores are strings. Also reported large latency spikes when sending ~500 candidates (endpoint timed out after retries).

Tomas (SDK): Initial thought: looks like SDK inadvertently serializes numeric scores as strings (to preserve precision) — server echoes them back and response parser leaves them as strings. Did we land any change around numeric serialization?

Jin (Eng): On runtime we always accept numbers. No changes on server that would stringify scores. Prob on SDK side.

Tomas (SDK): Confirmed: in v0.8.1 we added a small helper to coerce big decimals to strings for safety, but the guard is too broad and hits all float arrays (including rerank scores). That caused sending strings and the server response schema preserved the type. Bug.

Tomas (SDK): Short-term mitigation: instruct customer to coerce in their app: `res.scores = res.scores.map(s => parseFloat(s))` (or use `+s`). Also advise reducing candidate batch to <=200 while we investigate latency.

Sam (Billing): Customer also reports unexpectedly high token billing due to retry loop after 500ms timeouts — they retried the entire batch multiple times. We should advise exponential backoff + idempotency guidance.

Tomas (SDK): Working on a patch to revert the over-eager stringification and add explicit parseFloat on response path. I'll cut 0.8.2 with the fix.

DeployBot: Release 0.8.2 (canary us-west) rolled at 1764447805 :rocket:

Tomas (SDK): PR linked in internal review, quick changelog: 1) remove toFixed forcing on score arrays, 2) ensure response parser converts string scores to Number via parseFloat, 3) add unit tests for sorting stability.

Anya (Support): I've sent the workaround + ETA to customer. They appreciate the quick follow-up. Will confirm once 0.8.2 hits prod. :thumbsup:

Tomas (SDK): Follow-up: will monitor canary metrics (latency, error rate) and post updates here.

Jin (Eng): If latency persists for big candidate sets, we'll check batching config and KV cache pressure. For now doc the 200 candidate soft limit.

Anya (Support): Closing internal ticket after prod deploy and customer confirmation. Thanks team.
